text: Man loves company — even if it is only that of a small burning candle.
author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg
visual_brief: A precise engineering drawing of an automated weather beacon adrift in deep water, showing orthographic side elevations and a faint dash-line radius marking the reach of its low-power radio signal. The surrounding black space is vast and unmarked, emphasizing the tiny envelope of contact.
alt: Engineering line drawing of an isolated floating beacon transmitting into empty space
